proposals.diff_summary: Adds a 'Known flake, not a real finding' note for the duplicate zero-step 'AI / DeepSeek review' ghost check (bounces between unrelated workflow names, e.g. Secret Scanning/CI, fails instantly with no steps run) so it is recognized on sight instead of re-investigated from scratch each time. Adds a second, more consequential rule: verify `gh pr review --approve` actually landed (`gh pr view --json reviews` shows the account as APPROVED) before ever calling `gh pr merge`, and never batch the approve+merge calls together — because GitHub's self-approval rejection on the approve call does NOT block a merge call issued in the same batch from succeeding, which is exactly what happened in c9bbcd88 (an unreviewed PR got merged because the approve failure went unnoticed until the state was checked afterward). This same 'Can not approve your own pull request' string appears in 4 of the 10 sampled transcripts — not a one-off.
proposals.expected_impact: Prevents a real governance violation (merging without the required independent review) from recurring — not primarily a token-count optimization, but the highest-severity finding in this run. Secondarily saves the several tool calls per PR spent re-diagnosing the ghost-check pattern (observed 3x in a single session, c9bbcd88, across PRs #1353/#1374/#1408) once the known-flake note lets it be recognized in one `gh api .../jobs/<id>` check instead of a fresh investigation each time.

proposals.diff_summary: scripts/bootstrap_session.sh invokes `python3`, which resolves to a broken Windows Store alias stub on this machine, not the real interpreter (`python`). Every one of 7 of the 10 sampled sessions re-discovers this by trial and error (one session, d66505a1, re-hits it three separate times in the same run) before building an ad hoc PATH shim. Added a one-time shim snippet directly at the point board-status/SKILL.md already instructs running bootstrap_session.sh, so it is pre-empted instead of rediscovered. (scripts/bootstrap_session.sh itself is out of this skill's allowed optimization surface, so the fix is documented at the call site rather than in the script.)
proposals.expected_impact: Removes a predictable multi-turn detour (error message -> diagnose -> build shim -> retry) that recurred in 7/10 sampled sessions, several costing 2-4 turns each. Conservatively ~500-1500 tokens and 2-4 tool calls saved per session that needs bootstrap_session.sh on this machine, compounding every session until the environment itself changes.
